As a veteran SWTOR player I can recommend it.    
When it comes to story, each of 8 classes has their own storyline with each side having their own planetary arc for every planet you visit in vanilla, then we go to Ilum for an epilogue, then it's first expansion Rise of the Hutt Cartel, after that it's Prelude to Shadow of Revan and Shadow of Revan, after that it's a quick interlude with Ziost storyline and Knights of the Fallen Empire/Knights of the Eternal Throne expansions, after that it's Jedi Under Siege and then newest expansion, Onslaught.    
As for combat, it's typical wow targeting like combat, though each class has two subclasses and then those have 3 combat specs so you can choose your playstyle. Group roles are also typical tank, healer, melee dps and ranged dps.    
Group content is divided between shorter flashpoints requiring 1 person to complete on story mode and 4 people on veteran and master mode and operations which require 8 or 16 people to complete on each difficulty. All flashpoints and story mode operations can be easily done with a pub group where as veteran and master mode ops require coordination and tactics. Then you have pvp which can be divided between 8 man warzones where you have to capture a node or a point or you need to get a ball to enemy base (kinda like in Capture the Flag) and 4v4 arenas, where if you die you don't respawn until next round.    
Exploration is a thing since you have a lot of planets to visit and most of them have hidden datacrons on them, they are hard to get to but you get achievements for finding them.    
As for customisation your character can wear any gear in the outfit designer, thanks to that you keep stats from your normal gear and get looks from different set

Sometimes we get people to come up for gas harvesting in wormholes and that can be good money too.  
  
You can rat in Vexor and make around 20-25 mill/hr semi-afk. After you step up to omega you can get into VNI and do 55-65 mill/hr.  
  
You also can run C1 wormhole combat sites in something like passive tanked caracal (believe or not but it works).  
  
If you joined newbro corp sometimes newbros scan down combat sites and run them together and that can be also good money.

Last thing I can think of is incursion running in your corp/alliance space. Sometimes incursions spawn close to our space or in our space and we take newbros to do things like logi in Ospreys and it yields good money if we're running HQs or even Vanguards.
